QF.id: Cat III AIF Fees and Performance_42

question.text: When all capital calls are met, MOIC equals which other multiple?

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 201 says MOIC uses total returns divided by total invested capital. When all capital calls are met, total invested capital equals total paid-in capital, so TVPI equals MOIC. The Trap: DPI and RVPI capture only distributed or residual components; PIC Multiple measures called-versus-committed capital and does not capture returns. Note: The MOIC = TVPI identity only holds when every committed capital call has been met by investors.
